title: Landstede Hammers Pull Away After the Break to Capture the DBL Crown
description: Landstede Hammers are champions of the Netherlands once again, overpowering Zorg en Zekerheid Leiden 90-74 at a raucous Landstede Sportcentrum to wrap up the Dutch Basketball League title. For a half, Leiden hung tough. The visitors actually edged the second quarter to keep things close, trailing by just two at the interval after a high-scoring opening in which both sides shot better than 50 percent inside. But the Hammers seized control after the break, winning the third quarter 20-14 and then blowing the game open with a dominant 24-13 final period to turn a tight contest into a comfortable 16-point triumph.
imageCaption: Landstede Hammers Pull Away After the Break to Capture the DBL Crown (Photo: IG)

title: Den Bosch clinch DBL title
description: Den Bosch - ZZ Leiden 86-67 Den Bosch have been crowned the Dutch champions. They fired past ZZ Leiden to sweep the championship series. The hosts trailed by 1 point after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 12-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 86-67. Den Bosch made 19-of-25 free shots (76.0 percent) during the game. Den Bosch outrebounded ZZ Leiden 42-29 including 29 on the defensive glass. The best player for the winners was American guard Le'Tre Darthard (193-2000, college: Oklahoma) who scored 25 points, 6 rebounds, 5 assists and 4 steals (on 10-of-13 shooting from the field). He was named the Finals MVP. The international guard Charlon Kloof (190-1990, college: St.Bonaventure) chipped in 17 points. title: ZZ Leiden earn DBL title
description: ZZ Leiden - Den Bosch 92-81 ZZ Leiden conquered DBL title. They held off Den Bosch in Game 4 of the title series to take the crown. The game was mostly controlled by ZZ Leiden. Den Bosch managed to win second period 29-22. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. ZZ Leiden shot the lights out from three sinking 13 long-distance shots on high 59.1 percentage. The game was dominated by American players. Guard Tajion Jones (194-1999, college: UNC Asheville) fired 27 points (perfect from downtown making all seven shots !!!) for the winners. Forward Brock Gardner (201-1997, college: Master's, agency: Players Group) chipped in 19 points and 5 rebounds. Gardner is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. title: ZZ Leiden conquer 22/23 BNXT title
description: Oostende - ZZ Leiden 80-91 ZZ Leiden clinched the 22/23 BNXT League title. They overcame Oostende in the decisive third game of the championship series to lift the trophy. Deion Hammond (193-G-1999, college: Monmouth, agency: One Motive Sports) scored 22 points to lead the effort. ZZ Leiden recorded a 22-19 lead after ten minutes. They unloaded 30 points in the second stanza to take a 9-point lead at the interval. Oostende narrowed the deficit and eventually eked out a one-point lead at the final break. But ZZ Leiden responded with a massive 26-14 run in the fourth frame to secure the winning outcome. Marijn Ververs (194-G-1998) nailed 19 points in the win. Nikola Jovanovic (211-C/F-1994, college: USC) answered with 15 points, while Pierre-Antoine Gillet (201-PF-1991) had 13 points in the loss.
imageCaption: ZZ Leiden conquer DBL title (Photo: sleutelstad.nl)

title: Den Bosch upset ZZ Leiden to capture DBL trophy
description: ZZ Leiden - Den Bosch 74-81 Den Bosch clinched DBL title. They outgunned ZZ Leiden on the road in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. The guests trailed by 5 points after first quarter, but they rallied back to get the 3-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 81-74. Den Bosch made 21-of-25 free shots (84.0 percent) during the game. Den Bosch outrebounded ZZ Leiden 39-26 including 29 on the defensive glass. They looked well-organized offensively handing out 22 assists. The best player for the winners was American forward Clay Mounce (201-1998, college: Furman) who scored 23 points. The former international center Thomas van der Mars (208-1990, college: Portland, agency: Duran International) chipped in 6 points and 16 rebounds. title: Leiden crowned DBL champions
description: Leiden - Den Bosch 90-74 Leiden celebrated DBL title. They overcame Den Bosch on Thursday to complete the sweep of the championship series. The hosts trailed by 3 points after first quarter, but they stormed back to get the 6-point lead at the halftime and eventually won the game 90-74. Leiden looked well-organized offensively handing out 21 assists. The best player for the winners was American guard Giddy Potts (188-95, college: MTSU) who scored 17 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists. His fellow American import point guard Riley Lachance (188-96, college: Vanderbilt) chipped in 14 points and 5 assists.
